## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The save failure handling should be fixed because an unsuccessful write produces a success message and status.

## Changes
The pull request adds report saving and cleanup of optional temporary reports, with tests for successful saves, unavailable destinations, and cleanup behavior. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report failed writes to unavailable destinations — When you save to a path whose parent directory does not exist, `write_text` raises `FileNotFoundError`, but the handler discards it, prints “Report saved,” and returns `0`. — Users and automation cannot detect the failed save or identify why the requested report was not created.
